caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed, reddish-brown decorative vessel with a detailed lid. The vessel has a rounded body with two small, horizontal handles on each side, and subtle embossed floral patterns on its surface. The lid is ornate, featuring a tiered design with curved layers and bead-like decorations, topped by a cluster of rounded forms. The background is plain and light beige, providing contrast to the vessel. The artist's name, "ALVIN Shiren," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Covered Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
